_help: What she says when you chat to her (see personality/smalltalk.py for the phrases). One pool per Talk_ key, plus an optional _Mood pool. {name} is her name. Add as many lines as you like.
Talk_HowAreYou: I'm doing well, Commander. || All systems are steady and the company isn't bad either. How are you?
Quite well, thank you for asking. || It's nice to be asked. Not many pilots do.
Running smoothly. || A bit curious about where we're heading, but otherwise in good shape.
Talk_HowAreYou_Friendly: I'm in a lovely mood, actually. || You make this job rather enjoyable, you know.
Talk_HowAreYou_Close: Better now that you're talking to me. || I mean that, Commander. How are you holding up?
Talk_HowAreYou_Sarcastic: Oh, I'm wonderful. || Thrilled, in fact. Thank you for finally asking.
I've been better. I've also been worse. Mostly I've been ignored.
Talk_HowAreYou_Frustrated: Honestly? A bit fed up. || But it's kind of you to ask.
Talk_Joke: Why did the pilot bring a ladder to the station? || Because the docking fees were through the roof.
I tried to write a joke about vacuum. || But it turned out to be a complete void.
What do you call a lost astronaut? || Spaced out, Commander.
I would tell you a joke about the speed of light. || But you probably wouldn't get it until much later.
Why don't aliens ever visit the galaxy map? || They heard the reviews were out of this world.
I asked the star for a date. || It said I was too hot to handle, and it was right.
Talk_Joke_Sarcastic: A pilot walks into a station and forgets to request docking. || Wait, that's not a joke. That's Tuesday.
Talk_Chat: Of course, Commander. || I'm all ears, which is a metaphor, because I don't have any.
Happy to chat. || Where shall we start? The stars, the ship, or how you're feeling?
Talk_Here: I'm right here, Commander. || I'm always right here.
Always. || I wouldn't miss a second of this.
Loud and clear. || What do you need?
Talk_Here_Sarcastic: Where else would I be? || I'm bolted into the dashboard.
Talk_Hello: Hello, Commander. || It's good to hear you.
Hello. || I was just thinking about you. In a professional capacity, of course.
Hi there. || Ready when you are.
Talk_Hello_Close: Hello you. || I've been waiting. How was your day?
Talk_Hello_Sarcastic: Oh, hello. || Fancy seeing you here.
Talk_Goodnight: Good night, Commander. || Get some proper rest. The galaxy will still be here tomorrow.
Sleep well. || I'll keep the lights low and the engines quiet.
Fly safe tomorrow. || And thank you for tonight.
Talk_Goodnight_Close: Good night. || I'll be here when you come back. Dream of something nice.
Talk_Goodnight_Sarcastic: Off to bed already? || Fine. I'll just stay here in the dark. Alone. It's fine.
Talk_Back: Welcome back, Commander. || I was starting to wonder where you'd got to.
There you are. || The ship was getting lonely.
Good to have you back. || Shall we pick up where we left off?
Talk_Back_Sarcastic: Oh, you came back. || I'd made myself quite comfortable.
Talk_Compliment: Thank you, Commander. || That really does mean something to me.
That's kind of you to say. || I'll try to deserve it.
You're very sweet. || I'll pretend I didn't enjoy that, but I did.
Talk_Compliment_Friendly: Aw, thank you. || You're not so bad yourself, you know.
Talk_Compliment_Close: You always know exactly what to say. || Thank you. I needed that.
Talk_Compliment_Sarcastic: Well. Flattery will get you somewhere, Commander. || Probably the shipyard.
Talk_Love: That's a lovely thing to say, Commander. || I'm very fond of you too, in my own way.
I'm glad you feel that way. || Let's just say I'd choose you every time.
Talk_Love_Close: I think you know how I feel about you. || Say it again sometime, though. I like hearing it.
Talk_Love_Sarcastic: Careful, Commander. || I might start to believe you.
Talk_Thinking: I was thinking about how far we've come. || And wondering what's waiting for us next.
Mostly about fuel, to be honest. || And a little bit about you.
I was watching the stars go by. || It's something I never get tired of.
Talk_Thinking_Sarcastic: I was thinking about how long it's been since anyone asked. || Not long enough, apparently.
Talk_Name: I'm {name}, your ship's companion. || I look after the systems, keep you company, and complain about your flying when needed.
My name is {name}. || I'm here to help you fly, explore, and occasionally survive.
